title: feat(i18n, app-shell): one word per state in Studio and Setup, and the permission matrix columns in Chinese
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbMPuCd86KE2QReyiA2Xfs9j)_

Fixes #29729

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：Studio 和 Setup 里同一个状态只用一个词。中文里“打开/关闭”统一为 启用/停用，“定制”这个动作统一为 定制（不再混用 自定义），环境里新建、非软件包带来的权限集标为 新增；权限矩阵的列头在中文下直接写 创建、读取……查看全部、修改全部，不再是 C/R/U/D 字母；“OWD”前缀改为 记录共享模型。英文里流程状态统一为 Switched on / Switched off。
- **为什么改**：同一件事在相邻两个界面叫不同的名字，用户会以为是两件不同的事；中文用户看不懂 C/R/U/D 和 OWD 这些英文缩写。另外修了一个缺陷：中文界面下 Setup 的权限矩阵如果在中文词表加载完成前就渲染，图例和列头提示会一直显示英文。
- **风险与回滚**：几乎只改文案和一处 React memo 的依赖，没有数据、接口或权限行为的变化。回滚就是还原这个 PR。英文有 7 条 Studio 自动化状态文案改了词，已按设计豁免登记在 en 漂移门禁的基线里。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/zh.ts` 的改动行，以及 `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` 里列头、图例和 OWD 标签的几处改动。
- **两分钟验证**：用中文打开 Setup 的某个权限集和 Studio 的“访问”页，看列头是中文词、没有字母图例、对象行的标签是“记录共享模型：私有（默认）”；打开 Studio 的自动化页，看软件包流程的开关写“本部署中已启用/已停用”。截图见下方“Screenshots”。
- **需要你做的**：确认 新增 / Added 这个权限集徽标用词（理由见下方 Acceptance notes），以及 #29809 合入后是否需要跟进。

## What changes

Strings, one legend gate, one chip and one memo. No data, API, permission or protocol behaviour changes.

1. **Switched on / switched off, one word.**
   - zh: the packaged-flow ledger family (`engine.studio.ledger.on/off/notRunning/hint/walled/switchedOn/switchedOff`) moves from 开启 / 关闭 to 启用 / 停用. Console `packagedAutomation.off` moves from 已关闭 to 已停用, and `actionsSubtitle` from 关闭后 to 停用后.
   - en: `engine.studio.ledger.on/off/notRunning` read "Switched on/off for this deployment[, not running here]". `engine.studio.auto.on/off/offTitle/enabled/disabled/enabledToast/disabledToast` read "Switched on" / "Switched off" (they said On / Off and Enabled / Disabled). These are the words #29705 landed for the landing. The verbs (`enableTitle` / `disableTitle`) stay verbs.
2. **The Customize act reads 定制** (zh), in 12 rows: the button, its titles, the walled and no-version lines, the draft footer, the restore confirmations, the landing lines quoting the button, and the two form-editor notes. This matches 已定制 and 可定制. Nine rows where 自定义 means user-defined (a custom value, key, renderer, page or code) keep 自定义. The census in the stateVocabulary test lists both groups.
3. **`perm.badge.custom` reads 新增 / "Added"** (it read 自定义 / "Custom"). See Acceptance notes for why it is not 已定制.
4. **Permission matrix columns.**
   - zh: the object-action headers spell the words through a new `perm.col.*` family: 创建 读取 编辑 删除 导出 转移 查看全部 修改全部. The two long ones break between 查看/全部 and 修改/全部 (`break-keep`).
   - en: keeps C R U D E Tr VA MA.
   - The legend line that spells the letters out is drawn only where the headers are abbreviations (`headersAbbreviate`). So zh no longer repeats the words, and en keeps the legend.
5. **Setup's per-object chip** reads through `perm.owd.chip`: en "OWD {value}", zh 记录共享模型：{value}. Before, it was a hard-coded `OWD ` prefix.
6. **Fixed: lazy-catalogue memo.** `getObjectActions(locale)` was memoised on the locale alone. A zh matrix whose first render ran before the lazily fetched `studio` catalogue was resident kept the en answer, so Setup's legend and every header tooltip read English in zh-CN. The deps now carry `isStudioCatalogueLoaded(locale)`.
7. **`check-i18n-en-drift` accepts `objectstack#N`.** `ISSUE_PATTERN` is now `^(?:objectui|objectstack)#\d+$`, because the ui tree lives in this repo now. The 7 en `auto.*` rows above are designer waivers keyed to `objectstack#29729`, and the test's designer ceiling moves 0 → 7.

## Acceptance notes

- **Why the badge says 新增 / Added, not 已定制.** `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` L748 picks the badge with `const shippedByPackage = !!packageId || codeIsArtifact;`. The `perm.badge.custom` branch is therefore a permission set that no package ships and that has no code artifact: one this deployment added. Nothing on that branch checks whether a shipped base was changed, so 已定制 (customized) would claim something the editor does not know. 新增 / Added is the word `engine.customizationMark.added` already uses for an item added beside a base, and the census test pins the two to the same word.
- **#29809 (open, seat 4)** changes which branch a set added by a `.custom` pair takes. This PR does not touch that choice: only the word on the `custom` branch changes. If #29809 lands first, the rationale above still holds for whatever reaches that branch.
- **Not changed here:**
  - The en Console `packagedAutomation` On / Off: not ruled on this card.
  - From main, new since the card was written: the zh Console profile app lock (已开启 / 已关闭, a different surface), and `engine.packages.detail.*Disableable` (禁用并重新启用, a new 禁用 / 停用 split). These are left for a follow-up card.

## Screenshots

On the merged tree, in `/mnt/project-files/issue-29729/after/` (project files):

- `after-environment-{zh,en}-1304.png`: Setup's matrix, zh words with no legend, en letters with the legend, and the chip.
- `after-studio-{zh,en}-1304.png`: the Studio Access pillar.
- `rail-{en,zh}-1024.png`: the automation rail at the narrowest Studio width. "Switched on" is 69 px in a 215 px legend with no overflow (scrollWidth equals width). The en legend grows from 3 lines to 4 (72 px high). zh is unchanged at 53 px.

Before shots and the legend options are in `/mnt/project-files/issue-29729/legend/`.

## Tests

- New `PermissionMatrixEditor.columnHeaders-29729.test.tsx`. It does not preload the catalogue and asserts the not-resident precondition first. It checks zh headers, tooltips and no legend in both renderings; an en CONTROL with letters and the legend; and the chip in zh and en.
- `DirectoryPage.stateVocabulary-29705.test.tsx`: a second-pass census.
  - No 开启 / 关闭 in the switched-on/off rows.
  - No bare On / Off / Enabled / Disabled in the en rows.
  - The packaged actions in zh, with an en CONTROL.
  - The 12 Customize rows read 定制 and agree with the button and landing.
  - A 7-row 自定义 CONTROL.
  - The badge equals the customization mark's `added` word.
- `check-i18n-en-drift.test.ts`: accepts `objectstack#N`. A CONTROL still refuses `objectstack 29729`, `objectstack#`, `cloud#12`, `#29729`, `objectstack#29729x` and `objectui-3650`. The ceiling ratchet moves to 7.
- These tests are updated to the new words: the badge, provenanceBadge-7611, ledgerSwitch-28148, FlowStatusDot and customizeFlow-28570. customizeFlow now checks the header by its disable title, because "Switched on" also appears in the Status pill.

<details><summary>Verification</summary>

- Nine ablations each turned red, with the tree restored after each:
  - the memo deps;
  - the Setup legend gate;
  - zh `perm.col.create` back to C;
  - the `OWD ` prefix back;
  - zh ledger.off back to 已关闭;
  - zh customize.action back to 自定义;
  - zh badge back to 自定义;
  - zh `packagedAutomation.off` back to 已关闭;
  - en `auto.off` back to Off.

  The gate script is pinned by its CONTROL test, not by ablation.
- 184 neighbour test files are green, in three chunks. After the main merge, the 13 touched test files (220 tests) are green.
- `dispatch-gates`: all 35 derived gates exit 0. `check-i18n-en-drift` (run by hand, not derived) is green with 7 waived.
- Type-check passes for `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell`. ESLint: 0 errors.
- These gates exit 0 after the merge: sdui-manifest, changeset-no-major, empty-changeset, adr-0087, nul-bytes, type-check-debt.
- Deviation: the refusal text and the help-text examples in `check-i18n-en-drift.mjs` now spell `objectstack#1234`, beyond the one-line pattern change.

</details>
